intro: Shandris Feathermoon is the General of the Sentinel Army and the adopted daughter of Tyrande Whisperwind and Malfurion Stormrage. A veteran archer of the War of the Ancients, she now commands night elf military forces throughout Kalimdor from Feathermoon Stronghold on Sardor Isle off the coast of Feralas.

p: Ten thousand years ago during the War of the Ancients, the demonic Burning Legion destroyed the village of Ara-Hinam, separating a young Shandris from her family. Fleeing south, she was rescued by Kur'talos Ravencrest's forces and adopted by the Priestess of the Moon, Tyrande Whisperwind. Though initially forbidden from the battlefield, Shandris covertly shadowed the Sisters of Elune, proving herself an exceptional markswoman. When the satyr Xavius assaulted Malfurion Stormrage, Shandris struck the fiend with an arrow from the treeline, providing the opening Malfurion needed to entangle and neutralize the traitor.

Following the Great Sundering and the founding of the Sentinels, Shandris became an indispensable commander within the night elf military. Centuries later in the War of the Satyr, she led squads into brutal skirmishes against lingering demonic remnants, witnessing firsthand the tragic unleashed fury of the earliest worgen. During the Third War, Shandris led the Shadowleaves sentinels alongside Tyrande, standing upon the slopes of Mount Hyjal to defend the World Tree Nordrassil against Archimonde's legions.

Today, General Feathermoon serves as the supreme field commander of the Sentinel army. Stationed on Sardor Isle, she oversees Feathermoon Stronghold, an imposing elven fortress that keeps watch over the primal wilds of Feralas. From this island outpost, she monitors the encroaching threats of savage gnolls, lingering Gordunni ogres, hate-fueled satyrs, and the expanding power of the Horde in southern Kalimdor.
